name: indic-knowledge-graph
description: Cited answers about the Upanishads, Mahabharata, Ramayana and Vishnu Purana: the IKG MCP server (search, passages, entities, SPARQL, cited answers) and the ikg-scholar skill for using it with traceable citations

mcp_url.title: IKG MCP server URL
mcp_url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint of an IKG MCP server (`ikg mcp --http`, or `docker compose --profile mcp up -d mcp`). Use https:// for anything but a loopback address: the token is sent with every request

mcp_token.title: IKG MCP token
mcp_token.description: The server's IKG_MCP_TOKEN, sent as a Bearer token
